title: VCMI Game Transcript version 4
description: Schema for a VGT 4 YAML multi-document stream after parsing it into an array: the header is element zero and every later element is a turn or world document. Descriptions are the machine-readable documentation for fields and variants.

identifier.description: A compact reversible VGT identifier. The core namespace is implicit; hero/ and object/ are not format prefixes; located objects end in @x.y on the surface or @x.y.z on another level.

actor.description: The player, AI, world, neutral AI, or timer that chose an action.

playerColor.description: A VCMI player color or a special owner value such as neutral, unflaggable, or cannotDetermine.

queryId.description: A server query number, or one of the two non-numeric query sentinels.

position2D.description: An [x, y] adventure-map coordinate. It is only used where a sibling z field supplies the shared level.

resourceValues.description: Sparse resource mapping. Positive/negative values are deltas when the enclosing verb denotes a change; set* verbs contain absolute values.

playerSettings.description: Resolved or original lobby settings for one player slot.

mapGenerator.description: Random-map settings retained for provenance. Replay loads the saved and hashed map file instead of regenerating it.

header.description: The first YAML document. It contains everything needed to initialize deterministic replay from the referenced map.

uri.description: Map resource URI or path used by replay.

objectNameCounter.description: Initial unique object-name counter, needed for deterministic runtime object aliases.

startTime.description: Recorded initialization timestamp. It is input data, not the transcript wall-clock time.

gameSettingsOverrides.description: Open game-setting override tree; its keys are defined by the active ruleset and mods.

calendarDate.description: Calendar date as month/week/day-of-week; day zero is emitted as numeric zero.

phase.description: A startup chapter or the single global chapter applied before all players on a new day.

actor.description: Omitted when it is the player named by the turn document.

moveAction.description: One uninterrupted ordinary hero movement decision. Long routes use run-length compass steps; short routes contain [x,y] points and one shared z. A gate, monolith, whirlpool, embark/disembark, blocking visit, teleport, or level change ends this action.

examples.steps: SE E SE E*3 NE N NE

steps.description: Space-separated compass directions; *N run-length suffixes expand to N adjacent steps.

townBuildingAction.description: Builds, visits, or razes one named structure in a town; the enclosing record key selects the operation.

buildAction.description: One construction transaction. Cost is retained for readability and auditing; automatically granted derivative buildings are regenerated and are not listed.

recruitAction.description: One purchase or an ordered batch of consecutive purchases at the same source. paid is an audit result; remaining is included for a multi-purchase story when useful.

value.description: Raw server answer retained for exact replay.

text.description: Only genuine map-authored narrative or decision-bearing custom text.

encounterAction.description: A visit together with its optional prompt answer and ordered semantic results. An encounter without choice records a non-interactive visit result.

battleUnitName.description: Stable battle-local side/creature name, with a final ordinal segment when needed. Raw stack numbers are confined to the roster.

acceptedAs.description: Exceptional accepted action when the server transformed the request.

counterattack.description: The counterattack could not be folded into its initiating exchange because another meaningful event intervened.

battleAttack.description: One attack result with an immediate counterattack folded into retaliation. Derived healthDelta/operation fields are absent.

stack.description: The only raw stack number exposed outside embedded engine state.

battleOutcome.description: Consolidated result and ordered post-battle cleanup. Repeated resultAccepted/resultsApplied/ended packets are not format variants.

typedObject.description: Payload shared by the statically named audit/effect record variants. The record key is the discriminator. Open fields are explicitly embedded domain JSON or fields whose type varies by the discriminated record.

actor.description: Actor responsible for a local-state event.

player.description: Player whose state changed or who owns a query.

query.description: Query associated with a turn, dialog, or level-up.

result.description: Victory/loss, movement, or other enumerated outcome.

mode.description: Absolute/relative, learn/forget, or another operation mode selected by the record key.

object.description: Object alias, or null for a failed/null object creation.

id.description: Readable object alias or numeric runtime identifier, selected by the record kind.

movement.description: Movement points, or a list of per-hero new-turn movement values.

slot.description: Numeric army slot or named tavern/artifact slot.

erase.description: Artifact/stack erase operation, either boolean or structured.

nestedIntegerMap.description: Sparse entity-to-named-integers mapping. Signed values are changes; the enclosing set* record instead means absolute assignment.

creaturePool.description: Sparse creature-keyed available or growth pools. shared preserves one count shared by base/upgraded alternatives.

dailyRefresh.description: Absolute hero movement/mana values applied in the global new-day chapter.

text.description: Genuine map-authored description only; generated localization metadata is omitted.

storyEffect.description: Custom map narrative; standard generated UI boilerplate is never a story record.

turnStartEffect.description: Exceptional turn start carrying a live query; ordinary turn starts are represented by the document header.

turnEndEffect.description: Compact timer snapshots only; the endTurn decision already marks an ordinary boundary.

visibilityEffect.description: Exact fog delta compacted into inclusive horizontal x ranges.

townEffect.description: Exceptional independent town mutation. Normal construction is the semantic build transaction and omits derived buildings.

newObjectEffect.description: All non-derived data needed for a dynamically created map object; id-N becomes its stable alias.

queryEffect.description: Semantic shape of a decision-bearing server query. The query number remains the exact reply operand.

atomicRecord.description: One adventure action/effect record or one nested battle block. Unknown keys are rejected so an unmodelled format extension is visible to validators and generators.

contextualBuildRecord.description: Lexical at: scene shorthand for a build transaction; context ends with this mapping.

contextualMoveRecord.description: Lexical with: scene shorthand for one hero move; context ends with this mapping.

record.description: A closed discriminated record. Unknown keys and fields are invalid.
